data.long_meaning: The name Jatashankar is recorded with the meaning “Conqueror of all”. Jatashankar is a Hindu name meaning “Conqueror of all”. in_sanskrit.name: Jatashankar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Conqueror of all
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jatashankar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who has conquered all aspects of life and has gained supreme knowledge and power

in_hindi.name: Jatashankar
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Conqueror of all
in_hindi.long_meaning: Jatashankar एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who has conquered all aspects of life and has gained supreme knowledge and power

in_tamil.name: Jatashankar
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Conqueror of all
in_tamil.long_meaning: Jatashankar ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who has conquered all aspects of life and has gained supreme knowledge and power

in_telugu.name: Jatashankar
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Conqueror of all
in_telugu.long_meaning: Jatashankar ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who has conquered all aspects of life and has gained supreme knowledge and power

in_marathi.name: Jatashankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Conqueror of all
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jatashankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has conquered all aspects of life and has gained supreme knowledge and power

in_bengali.name: Jatashankar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Conqueror of all
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jatashankar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has conquered all aspects of life and has gained supreme knowledge and power
